# Traceability Matrix

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document | Traceability matrix |
| Status | Living document (no approval gate) |
| Last updated | YYYY-MM-DD |

| Goal(s) | User stories | Requirement | Priority | Status | Acceptance criteria | ADRs | UI items | Tasks | Test cases | Latest result (report) | QA status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PG-… | US-… | FR-001 | P0 | APPROVED | AC-… | ADR-… | UI-… | TASK-… | TC-… / NOT CREATED | Pass / Fail / NOT RUN (test-report-…) | Verified / Failed / Not verified |

Columns are added by the phase that creates them: requirements (goal to AC, test placeholders), architecture
(ADRs), design (UI items), plan (tasks), testing (test cases and results), QA (status). There is one
matrix for the project: `docs/01-requirements/REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md`.

## Coverage gaps
- Requirements with no task: …
- Tasks with no tests: …
- P0 requirements without a passing test: …
